Call a read-only tool on a registered project MCP server, without approval. Permitted operations are a fixed, server-side allowlist (object_contract, registry_get, object_inventory, object_get, object_list, object_validate, ping, list_sources, list_connections, search_offers, performance, demand_signals, explain_decision) — never caller-supplied; anything else is refused before any transport with code "read_tool_operation_not_permitted". Still honors the project's own toolPolicies/defaultToolPolicy and the executable project policy (legacy artifact fallback blocks) — a project can still block a read op. Use project.call_tool for writes.

Create or poll the capture job for a source URL under the target project's capture policy (registry-resolved, deny-all default), through the TARGET SITE's own capture bridge. Without jobId: creates the job and returns {phase:'pending', jobState}. With jobId: polls once — 'pending' until terminal, then {phase:'completed', envelope} carrying the snapshot.v1, read back through the bridge's get_capture_snapshot.
Deterministic heuristic mapping of a snapshot.v1 into governed candidates + the declined-block ledger (vendored platform map.mjs).
Deterministic bounded theme quantization from a snapshot.v1's computed styles (vendored platform theme.mjs).

Deterministic capture emission (vendored platform emit.mjs). Default is the DRY-RUN plan (no MCP call). live:true executes the plan against the target project's governed verbs as NEVER-RELEASED DRAFTS.
Deterministic capture fidelity scoring (vendored platform score.mjs): mapped-block coverage against the project's rubric, theme completeness, gap enumeration, consolidated gap report.
Assembles the BOUNDED clone briefing the judgment nodes read: live component/page-type registries, brandTokens, captured theme tokens, per-page shape records, existing recipe summaries.
Re-validates recipe_designer's section_template/template designs against the target's LIVE component and page-type registries and creates the survivors as governed DRAFT recipes, reuse-first.

Writes theme_reconciler's reconciled tokens onto the capture run's own theme object, then applies that theme to the site through site_apply_theme under a site checkout — the ONLY sanctioned palette writer. Exact-replace only; refuses partial coverage (theme_not_total).
Re-assembles each mint survivor's captured pages onto its recipe through object_checkout -> object_patch(upsert_section) -> object_checkin, preserving every bound asset reference byte-identical.

Deterministic EV-floor arithmetic for an offer: floorUsd = the run's REAL accrued cost x floorMultiplier; expectedValueUsd = payoutUsd x conversionRate x estimatedVolume when supplied; meetsFloor compares the two. Never invents a run cost, a payout, or a conversion estimate.
